top.title: Mina Kimes assigns blame for the Aaron Rodgers-Mike McCarthy controversy
top.description: Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Aaron Rodgers’ controversial comments about Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy drew all sorts of reactions online, but they probably shouldn’t have come as the biggest surprise, considering their tenure together with the Green Bay Packers also ended poorly, albeit in a much less public manner. Their reunion lasted 10 games before the Steelers released a shocking statement late Tuesday night announcing Rodgers had been benched and wouldn’t play in this week’s game. Rodgers went scorched earth on Wednesday’s episode of The Pat McAfee Show , accusing McCarthy of repeatedly falling asleep during team meetings, alluding to the Steelers’ head coach struggling to keep up with the rigors of coaching an NFL team, and maintaining that the coach held a grudge against him from how things ended in Green Bay. Following Rodgers tell-all, McCarthy danced around the accusations and asserted that he is still the right man to lead the franchise. Reports emerged that suggested that Rodgers gave Pittsburgh an ultimatum over play-calling responsibilities , and the franchise called him on it, resultin in his benching. Rodgers has received the lion’s share of the blame for airing out his dirty laundry in a public manner, but ESPN’s Mina Kimes, at least, thinks that the Steelers should have seen this coming. “The Steelers organization is the one who deserves the most blame. The front office and ownership,” Kimes said. “It was all so god damn predictable. That’s what I’ll say. Everybody was shocked when this reunion happened cause we all knew they didn’t like each other.” Kimes added that “the football was also very predictable,” noting that Rodgers and the Steelers offense were putting up league-worst numbers. “It’s not like the Steelers didn’t know any of this,” she continued. “They made a terrible football decision, but also a terrible people management decision. And they, to me, deserve more blame than anyone in all this. “This was a disaster entirely of their own making. It was kinda the most predictable ending to all this, and nobody should be surprised… It’s like when you have two friends who are exes who get back together, and every single person in the friend group is like, ‘This is a horrible idea,’ but nobody will say it to their faces.” The post Mina Kimes assigns blame for the Aaron Rodgers-Mike McCarthy controversy appeared first on The Comeback: Today’s Top Sports Stories & Reactions .

top.title: AF Corse Expands IMSA GTD Effort For 2027 Season
top.description: A driver navigates the course during the GTP/GTD Pro Practice 1 session for the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship at the Chevrolet Detroit Grand Prix presented by Lear in Detroit on Friday, May 29, 2026. AF Corse is no longer just a guest at the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship. In 2027, the Italian team will launch its inaugural full-season GTD campaign. They will field the No. 50 Ferrari 296 GT3 EVO across the entire schedule. This move comes after the team won the 2025 GTD title and secured six WeatherTech Championship wins. The plan includes a second car, the No. 21, reserved for the Rolex 24 At Daytona. Matias Perez Companc and Nicklas Nielsen will drive the full season in the No. 50 entry, according to Sportscar365 . The team made this announcement on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026. The shift to a full season shows a major commitment to the American series. It builds on a history of strong endurance racing results. This lineup brings together experienced racers and official factory drivers. A New Era for the No. 50 Ferrari The core of this effort is the partnership between Matias Perez Companc and Nicklas Nielsen. Perez Companc has a deep history with the program. He competed in the GT World Challenge America Pro class last season. He and Frederik Schandorff won an overall race at Barber Motorsports Park in September. Nielsen brings his own experience to the seat. He raced in the team’s Hypercar program for the FIA World Endurance Championship over the last two seasons. The car itself is the Ferrari 296 GT3 EVO. Following the Phoenix Suns ’ 116-104 loss to the Houston Rockets during NBA Cup play Wednesday night, forward Dillon Brooks addressed his heated exchange with Kevin Durant that resulted in his ejection in the closing seconds of the game. Brooks received his second technical foul with 23.8 seconds remaining in the fourth quarter after exchanging words with Durant, who also received a technical foul. top.title: Milan fight back to beat Olympiacos in Europa League
top.description: FILE PHOTO - The UEFA Europa League logo is pictured at the Europa-Park Stadium. (is associated with: «Milan fight back to beat Olympiacos in Europa League») Harry Langer/dpa AC Milan produced a second-half fightback from 2-0 down to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Piraeus and kick-start their Europa League campaign. After a low-key start at the Stadio Georgios Karaiskakis, Olympiacos broke the deadlock from a corner in the 31st minute. Former Inter defender Lorenzo Pirola crashed a header against the crossbar and the ball bounced back into the net off Mike Maignan’s arm. Milan – who had lost three of their four previous Europa League games – were close to a swift equalizer in the 35th minute. Alphadjo Cisse raced onto a through pass as Olympiacos keeper Stefan Ortega rushed out, and then stabbed the loose ball goalwards only for Pirola to hack it clear as he slid on into a post. Pirola then missed a chance to double Olympiacos’ lead in stoppage time at the end of the first half when he fired over from 10 yards. Olympiacos, who were unbeaten in Europe with three wins, scored again four minutes into the second half. Remo Freuler found Jota Silva at the edge of the penalty area and he fired the ball past Maignan into the top corner. Milan got themselves back into the match through a fine individual goal from Omari Hutchinson in the 56th minute. The on-loan Nottingham Forest winger picked the ball up on the halfway line and burst down the right before cutting inside at the edge of the penalty area and rolling the ball into the far corner. The Rossoneri struck again in the 63rd minute when Hutchinson sent over a floated cross from the right towards the back post where Cisse nodded the ball past Ortega. Substitute Christian Pulisic completed the turnaround with 20 minutes left when he volleyed home a cross from the right after more quick footwork from Hutchinson. Diego Moreira swept home a fourth in added time following a swift counterattack by Pulisic.

top.title: Rayan fires 10-man Bournemouth to Europa League victory at Celta Vigo
top.description: FILE PHOTO - Bournemouth manager Marco Rose salutes the fans following the English Premier League soccer match between AFC Bournemouth and Nottingham Forest at Vitality Stadium. (is associated with: «Rayan fires 10-man Bournemouth to Europa League victory at Celta Vigo») Steven Paston/PA Wire/dpa Bournemouth moved a step closer to automatic qualification for the Europa League last 16 after coming from behind with 10 men to win 2-1 at Celta Vigo. It was a remarkable 10th victory in a row in all competitions for Marco Rose’s side and it might have been the most satisfying of the lot for the manager, coming as it did after his team had found themselves a goal down and a man down at half-time. The visitors looked in trouble when, minutes after Iago Aspas had curled Celta in front, Bafode Diakite was red-carded for a poorly timed tackle. Bournemouth might have folded then, but instead they came roaring back, Alvaro Rodriguez heading them level almost immediately after the start of the second half. A draw would have been an excellent result in the circumstances. Substitute Rayan had other ideas, waiting at the end of a rapid breakaway to sweep in the winner 12 minutes from time. Victory against Viktoria Plzen in December will almost certainly now be enough to earn direct passage to the last 16.

top.description: New Canaan celebrates a touchdown on a blocked punt return by Dallas George (11) against Darien during the Turkey Bowl football game on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026. New Canaan forced two turnovers which led to touchdowns in the first 3:05 and rolled to its ninth consecutive Turkey Bowl victory 33-13 over Darien Thursday in Darien. The No. 4-ranked Rams (8-2) had already unofficially secured a Class L tournament berth before the game, but the victory secured a home game for the quarterfinals, which are set for Tuesday. Darien (6-4) can still qualify for the Class L playoffs, but would need bonus points to fall its way. New Canaan's defense was in takeaway mode in the first few minutes. Three plays later, Jack Crowell scored on a six-yard run for a 7-0 lead. On the Blue Wave's next possession, Dallas George intercepted a High Dunlop pass and set New Canaan up at the Darien four-yard line. George then carried it in for a four-yard touchdown run and an early 14-0 lead. Kicker Neel Arora followed with field goals of 32 and 35 yards, and a blocked punt by Jack Nicolet led to a 13-yard return by George and the Rams had a 27-0 lead at halftime. top.title: Ohio State gets more bad news as criticism mounts for Ryan Day
top.description: An Ohio State Buckeyes helmet sits behind the endzone as the team warms up for its game against the Michigan Wolverines during the NCAA football game at Michigan Stadium in Ann Arbor, Mich. on Nov. 29, 2025. Ohio State won 27-9. It’s been a rough few weeks for the Ohio State Buckeyes and head coach Ryan Day. Ohio State has dropped three of its last four games and fallen out of the College Football Playoff picture, and the pressure on Day has only continued to grow heading into Saturday’s game against the Michigan Wolverines. Now, things have gotten even worse. Five-star edge rusher David “DJ” Jacobs, one of the top recruits in the country, has decommitted from Ohio State on Thanksgiving, just two days before the Buckeyes’ rivalry game and days before the early signing period. Ohio State’s Disappointing Season The Buckeyes entered the season with national championship expectations, but they’ve stumbled to a 7-4 record. Ohio State lost to Texas in Week 2, then fell to USC, Oregon, and Nebraska after star quarterback Julian Sayin suffered a season-ending arm injury. The criticism has been coming from everywhere. Ohio State legend Cris Carter ripped the program this week, questioning the communication within the coaching staff and saying that “the film looks like we ain’t got no heart.” Some Buckeye fans have already laid out the case for firing Day , pointing to the program’s failures in player development and game management. And with Michigan coming to Columbus on Saturday, Day’s seat is only going to get hotter if the Buckeyes lose. top.title: 3 storylines for Alabama vs. Auburn in Iron Bowl showdown
top.description: On Saturday night, one of college football's premier annual rivalries will be renewed when Alabama hosts Auburn for the latest chapter of the Iron Bowl. A storied matchup between two in-state foes, the Crimson Tide have faced Auburn countless times before with high stakes attached, with some of the biggest meetings coming during the Nick Saban era. That has carried over to the Kalen DeBoer era, with this latest matchup once again featuring high stakes for the Crimson Tide in particular. Alabama will enter the Iron Bowl ranked No. 6 in the latest College Football Playoff rankings , as well as still in the mix for a trip to the SEC Championship Game. As a result, when it comes to making the playoff, all the Tide have to do is win and they are in. Following are three storylines to watch for Saturday night when Alabama and Auburn collide in the latest Iron Bowl. Will Alabama continue recent Iron Bowl success in Tuscaloosa? Not only has Alabama won the last six games against Auburn dating back to the 2020 season, but the Crimson Tide have also owned the recent series in Tuscaloosa winning the last seven, with each game's margin of victory coming by double digits. The last Auburn team to win in Tuscaloosa was the Tigers' 2010 national title winning squad led by Heisman Trophy winning quarterback Cam Newton. Auburn won that game with a second half comeback, 28-27. Can Alabama's defense contain Byrum Brown? Saturday will mark the third time Alabama's defense has faced Auburn quarterback Byrum Brown in his career, with the former USF transfer having torched the Tide on the ground with 200 rushing yards in two prior games, despite struggling as a passer. Brown is certain to provide challenges for the Tide's defense again Saturday when running the ball, and will likely need to see success on the ground as Auburn's leading rusher has been hurt at times this season by turnovers, throwing eight picks. Can Alabama's pass rush take advantage of Auburn offensive line? Alabama's defensive front will be facing an Auburn offensive line that has struggled to protect the quarterback this season, with the Tigers currently ranking among the worst in FBS with 39 sacks allowed over 11 games. Alabama is tied for the fifth-most sacks in the SEC this season with 31, and have racked up a combined 13 during their current four-game winning streak. top.title: Eight Short Game Shots Define Scoring Mastery For Serious Golfers
top.description: Jerod Ringwald-Imagn Images A solid short game turns a bad round into a great one by saving strokes inside 80 yards. Golf Monthly identifies eight key shots every player must master to handle sand, rough, and slopes. These include the chip-and-run, chip-pitch, pitch, bunker shot, hybrid bunt, flop, upslope or downslope play, and a shot from the rough. The chip-and-run is the starting point for any good short game when obstacles are absent. According to reports, the shot allows the ball to start rolling earlier and leaves a large amount of green ahead. This method is the safest and most predictable way to knock the ball near the hole. Players should grip down the shaft and stand closer to the ball with 70% of their weight on the front foot. The Chip-Pitch And Pitch Shots When a player needs more carry than a chip but less speed than a full shot, the chip-pitch becomes the answer. This shot works well when a golfer is around 20 yards off the green and has room for the ball to release upon landing. The setup mirrors the chip-and-run but requires a slightly different feel to get the ball airborne without losing control. A standard pitch shot offers even higher flight and more distance. The motion involves more wrist action than the chip, allowing the player to stop the ball quickly on the green. Davies proposes visualizing wrist cock on a zero to five scale, with five indicating the maximum usage for a flop shot. Bunker And Hybrid Bunt Techniques Bunker play requires a specific technique to escape sand without losing distance or direction. The hybrid bunt can be used when a standard wedge does not work. The flop shot demands the most wrist action and is used to get the ball high and soft over an obstacle. It is the most difficult shot on the list and requires a precise touch to avoid hitting it too far or too short. Players must feel the clubhead slide under the ball while keeping their hands ahead of the clubhead at impact. Dealing With Slopes And Rough Slopes affect play, requiring players to adjust their aim and club selection for upslope or downslope lies. A shot from the rough adds another layer of difficulty as thick grass grabs the clubface and reduces spin. Converting three or four shots down to two elevates a player’s game to the next level. Davies stresses that sharp play from inside 80 yards lets a golfer exploit par 5s and short par 4s. The top five finishers at the Final Stage of PGA Tour Q School will earn membership for 2027.

nigeria.title: Trump demands probe into ‘fake’ US GDP figures
nigeria.description: President Donald Trump called Thursday for an investigation into a routine revision of economic growth figures as he pushed his groundless claims of interference in the US midterm elections. Trump lashed out at what he called “FAKE” figures a day after the US Commerce Department strongly revised GDP growth in the third quarter up to 4.3 percent from the previous estimate of 3.4 percent. Such updates are commonplace. “Why wasn’t the correct number issued before the Election? I am asking for an immediate investigation of this situation,” Trump said on his Truth Social network. “This is not a small error, this is a massive, and purposeful, error.” Trump followed up in a lengthy second post for the US Thanksgiving holiday in which he also took aim at a series of perceived enemies and critics of his extensive makeover of the White House. “I would like to wish a Happy Thanksgiving to even those who issued fake Economic Numbers, just prior to the Election, and corrected them yesterday, three weeks late,” wrote Trump. He added that it was a “RECORD SETTING ERROR, and one so grave that it should be immediately investigated.” Trump’s allegation of deliberate action echoes his other recent baseless claims calling into doubt his Republican Party’s brutal defeat in the November 3 midterm elections. Democrats won control of Congress as voters hammered Trump’s Republicans over economic headwinds sparked by the Iran war and the president’s chaotic tariff policies. Throughout his two presidencies, the 80-year-old Trump has repeatedly attacked the political, legal and economic norms that have long underpinned US democracy. Trump has previously defended his economic performance by pointing to data like GDP growth, which has been robust despite the headwinds, mainly on the back of the AI boom. Issuing its new GDP estimate on Wednesday, the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Economic Analysis said the growth “primarily reflected an acceleration in investment and an upturn in government spending that were partly offset by a downturn in exports.” Vanguard News The post Trump demands probe into ‘fake’ US GDP figures appeared first on Vanguard News .

nigeria.title: FG hails Davido, Asake, others over 2027 Grammy nominations
nigeria.description: By Enitan Abdultawab The Federal Government has congratulated Nigerian music stars Davido, Tems, Asake, Ayra Starr, Wizkid and Burna Boy following their nominations for the 69th Grammy Awards. The Minister of Art, Culture, Tourism and Creative Economy, Hannatu Musawa, congratulated the artistes in a post on her official X account on Thursday, describing their nominations as a source of pride for the country. Musawa noted that Nigerian artistes accounted for three of the five nominees in the Best Global Music Album category and featured in four of the five entries for Best African Music Performance. “Your music travels because it is yours. Every record also employs producers, engineers, dancers and crews, and protecting what creators own is at the heart of our work,” she wrote. She added that the country would be cheering the Nigerian nominees at the awards ceremony scheduled for February 7, 2027. The Recording Academy announced the nominees on November 16, with the six Nigerian artistes earning recognition across five categories. In the Best African Music Performance category, Asake received a nomination for his song ‘Gratitude’, while his collaboration with Wizkid, ‘Jogodo’, also made the list. Tems was nominated for ‘Big Daddy’, while Ayra Starr earned a nod alongside Beninese singer Angélique Kidjo for their collaboration, ‘Aye Kan (Are You Coming Back?)’. Davido, Ayra Starr and Tems also secured nominations in the Best Global Music Album category for their respective projects, ‘Oriadé’, ‘Starrgirl’ and ‘Love Is a Kingdom’. Burna Boy earned a nomination in the Best Global Music Performance category for ‘Dìá Dìá’, his collaboration with Colombian singer Shakira. nigeria.title: UNICEF, NGE, DAME others make case for 18.3m out-of-school children
nigeria.description: By Chioma Obinna & Juliet Umeh Media leaders, government officials and development partners have called for urgent action to address Nigeria’s child welfare and education challenges, raising concern over the 18.3 million out-of-school children in the country. They warned that poverty, insecurity, displacement, poor learning conditions and inadequate investment in maternal and child healthcare were undermining the survival, development and future of millions of Nigerian children. The stakeholders spoke at the 2026 World Children’s Day High-Level Media Symposium in Lagos, organised by UNICEF Nigeria in partnership with the Nigerian Guild of Editors, NGE, and the Diamond Awards for Media Excellence, DAME. In his opening address, President of the NGE, Mr Eze Anaba, challenged government, media organisations, community leaders and the private sector to take responsibility for the growing number of children without access to education. Citing a UNICEF report that put the number of out-of-school children at 18.3 million, Anaba said: “It’s our collective responsibility to ask why. “In a country of about 200 and something million people and 18 million plus of that population is on the streets, not going to school. It’s not only alarming. It’s a collective responsibility.” He questioned whether stakeholders were doing enough to address the crisis, asking: “Have we reminded government? Community leaders, have they done their part? Has the media done enough? The private sector, has it done enough?” Anaba also raised concerns over the location of some public schools close to bus stops, motor parks and train stations, warning that such environments could expose children to negative influences at a critical stage of their development. nigeria.title: Lawal reaffirms refusal to negotiate with bandits
nigeria.description: By Idris Salisu, Gusau Zamfara State Governor, Dauda Lawal, has reiterated his administration’s decision not to negotiate with bandits terrorising the state, insisting that efforts would instead focus on reclaiming ungoverned areas and restoring security. Lawal stated this on Thursday at the graduation ceremony of the Zamfara Forest Guards held at Government Secondary School, Gada Biyu, Gusau. More than 1,000 forest guards graduated after undergoing training in weapons handling, physical fitness, combat readiness, civil-military relations, security cooperation, community engagement and the rule of law. The armed forest guard initiative was launched by President Bola Tinubu on May 24, 2025, to train residents to secure forests and other ungoverned areas across the country. At the ceremony, Lawal expressed appreciation to Tinubu and the National Security Adviser for the Federal Government’s support for the initiative. He also commended security agencies, the training coordinator and instructors for their roles in preparing the guards for service. Addressing the graduates and their families, the governor said Zamfara needed to reclaim its vast ungoverned areas, which he said had become hideouts for bandits and other criminal groups. “We must urgently reclaim Zamfara’s vast ungoverned areas, which have become safe havens for bandits, criminals and terrorists. “This will require sustained cooperation between federal and state authorities, a reliable security presence and the restoration of public services. “Our goal is to ensure displaced families can return safely, and communities can farm, trade and rebuild their livelihoods,” he said. The governor said his administration had invested substantially in security agencies over the past three years through the provision of operational equipment, vehicles, surveillance technology and logistical support. He listed the equipment provided to security agencies as more than 30 Armoured Personnel Carriers, 200 operational pick-up vehicles, 20 Toyota Buffalo vehicles and over 1,000 specialised motorcycles. He added that additional vehicles and motorcycles had also been supplied to the Homegrown Community Protection Guards. On surveillance, Lawal said the state had acquired drones, including an 80-metre endurance model capable of covering up to 50 kilometres and operating continuously for eight hours. According to him, the equipment would improve reconnaissance, situational awareness and coordination in difficult terrain. INEC stressed that the exercise was not an election, adding that no voter would cast a ballot for any candidate or political party. It urged residents of the affected polling units, community leaders, political parties, civil society organisations and journalists to cooperate with its officials to ensure a successful exercise. The Commission also cautioned against the spread of rumours and fake news, urging residents to obtain election-related information only through its official communication channels. It said the mock accreditation exercise was part of its early preparations to ensure the smooth deployment of technology and the conduct of credible elections in 2027. nigeria.title: Mock Accreditation: INEC Faces Crucial Test As 100 Million Voters Await 2027 Elections
nigeria.description: With exactly 50 days before Nigerians return to the ballot, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) is preparing for a nationwide test that could offer an important indication of whether the country is ready for another fiercely contested general election. On Saturday, November 28, the electoral umpire will deploy its Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) and electronic results upload technology across 17,676 selected polling units in a mock exercise designed to identify operational weaknesses, test equipment reliability and strengthen public confidence ahead of the 2027 elections. The exercise, scheduled for 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m., will cover two polling units in each of the country’s 8,838 registration areas, giving INEC an opportunity to assess the performance of its electoral technology across different locations before the presidential and National Assembly elections on January 16, 2027, and the governorship and State Houses of Assembly elections on February 6. #OsunDecides2026: Election Officers Take Delivery Of Materials, Mobilise To Polling Units during the Osun State governorship election on August 15, 2026. Chairman of INEC, Joash Amupitan, described the mock exercise as an important part of preparations for the forthcoming elections, while urging Nigerians to participate. The commission’s Director of Voter Education and Publicity, Victoria Meci, explained that the exercise would allow INEC to establish the effectiveness and reliability of its equipment before election day. “We don’t want to wait till the elections before we test the ruggedness, readiness and functionality of the system,” she said during an appearance on Channels Television’s Sunrise Daily . According to her, the commission has reduced the accreditation threshold to 850 voters per BVAS device, with additional machines to be provided at polling units with larger voter populations. The exercise will also test the electronic upload of results to IReV, although Meci acknowledged that successful transmission would depend on network availability. 100 Million Voters, 176,846 Polling Units The scale of the preparations reflects the size of Nigeria’s electorate. nigeria.description: Edo State Governor, Monday Okpebholo, has denied allegations linking him, the All Progressives Congress (APC), or its supporters to the alleged violent attack on members of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) during the party’s activities in Benin City, the state capital. Speaking at the APC presidential campaign rally in Ehor, headquarters of Uhunmwonde Local Government Area, and Ekpoma in Esan West, the governor described the allegations as unfounded, insisting that neither the state government nor the APC had any reason to disrupt opposition political activities. ﻿ Okpebholo alleged that the incident involved irresponsible elements who were fighting among themselves, dismissing claims of government involvement. He said his priority remained the development of Edo State, stressing that he would not divert his attention to political violence or activities capable of undermining the progress of the state. The governor recalled that he did not engage thugs during his senatorial and governorship campaigns, alleging that a police officer was killed during the governorship election by individuals he claimed were linked to the opposition. He also vowed to sustain his administration’s crackdown on cultism and other criminal activities, insisting that elections should be conducted based on the principle of one man, one vote. Okpebholo urged residents to participate actively in the electoral process, while thanking APC supporters for their turnout at the rally. Earlier, Deputy Governor Dennis Idahosa urged the people to vote for APC candidates across all levels in the 2027 general elections, while party chairman Jarrett Tenebe commended the governor’s efforts in tackling kidnapping and cultism, urging continued support for President Bola Tinubu and other APC candidates. Political thugs on Wednesday attacked the campaign convoy and campaign office of the NDC in Benin City, after the party said it received an intelligence report on a possible attack at its town hall meeting in Benin, where its presidential candidate, Peter Obi, was expected to address supporters. The Edo State Coordinator of the party’s campaign council, John Yakubu, said the party had been informed of plans to disrupt the event, as members prepared to leave their campaign office to receive Obi at the airport. Videos obtained by our correspondent showed blood stains on the party convoys, including bullet casings seen on the floor of the party’s campaign office. The incident came barely 48 hours after former deputy senate president, Ovie Omo-Agege’s campaign convoy was also attacked during an NDC campaign in Uduere community, Ughelli North Local Government Area, in Delta State on Monday. Last week, the Edo State Police Command commenced an investigation into an attack on the NDC secretariat in Afuze, Owan East Local Government Area, by armed men alleged to be members of the Edo State Security Network. business.title: Bitcoin Has Become Boring, Finally
business.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Has Become Boring, Finally The 2019 Lightning conference in Berlin was lit: five hundred “cypherpunks” getting each other high on visions of a future with peer-to-peer electronic cash. Attending a bitcoin conference back in the day felt like being a teenager at a friend’s party while their parents were out of town. It was exciting and new. The feeling was the opposite of FOMO: something big was happening, we were on the inside, and the rest of the world was going to envy us. It was the kind of party that you could only have when the adults weren’t looking. Whenever someone bought a beer (with bitcoin), everyone would hoot and holler and record it on their phones for Instagram/Twitter (it was still called Twitter). Lightning was the bleeding edge. We called it “the Lightning Network” (capitalized, if you please), and talking about it felt like talking about string theory: something so far out you’re not even sure it’s real. I spent a lot of time invoking the abacus . Those are the times some of us remember fondly and keep trying to relive at bitcoin conferences today. That’s why we engage in rituals like drone shows, Satoshi Rockamoto sets, beefsteak dinners , and video game tournaments for sats, but it’s not the same. The ratio of bitcoin OG speakers to suits is shifting. Many event rooms are half empty, and the halls and meeting rooms are full of people negotiating cap tables and profit-sharing splits. The adults haven’t shut the party down, but they have crashed it, and it kinda feels like their party now. The most exciting thing I noticed at the last bitcoin conference I attended was that nothing exciting happened. And that’s worth celebrating. People work harder on a project when they feel strongly about it and identify closely with like-minded collaborators. That’s where tech subcultures, their rituals, and their dogmas come from. But such passion and tribalism feed conflict, at least for a while until the tech goes mainstream, and normies, who couldn’t care less about subculture squabbles, take over. This progression from an exciting new technology that inspires strong emotions to a humdrum utility is not unusual. World-changing innovations often (always?) start with a committed subculture that identifies fiercely with their weird tech before the mainstream adopts it and soon expects it. Ade Ajayi Main Auditorium, University of Lagos. What will it take to make credit more accessible to African businesses and individuals? At the fourth edition of Africa Credit Expo (ACE) 202 6, stakeholders across financial services, technology, policy, investment and entrepreneurship examined the role of reliable credit information, financial inclusion and collaboration in expanding access to capital. Powered by CreditRegistry and supported by Afreximbank , the Expo was held on Friday, 13 November 2026, at the J. F. Ade Ajayi Main Auditorium, University of Lagos. Themed “Reimagining Africa’s Credit Economy: Unlocking Capital, Trust and Opportunity,” the event provided a platform for conversations on the systems, innovations and partnerships shaping the future of credit across the continent. Building Trust and Expanding Access to Capital Discussions at the Expo explored the role of credible credit information in building trust between lenders and borrowers. Reliable data enables financial institutions to assess risk more effectively and make informed lending decisions, while individuals and businesses with established credit histories are better positioned to demonstrate their credit worthiness. The conversations also considered the financing constraints facing micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). Despite their contribution to employment and economic activity, many small businesses continue to encounter barriers to affordable financing. Improving access to relevant financial products and strengthening credit information systems remain important to addressing these gaps. Technology, Financial Inclusion and the Next Generation Digital innovation and data intelligence featured prominently in discussions about the future of credit. Alternative credit assessment approaches have the potential to broaden access for individuals and businesses with limited formal credit histories. However, the expansion of digital financial services must be accompanied by responsible lending practices, consumer protection and transparency. The Expo also placed attention on young people through student-focused sessions and discussions on financial literacy. These conversations connected access to credit with the need for individuals to understand financial management, borrowing and long-term wealth creation. This focus reflects the February 2026 memorandum of understanding between CreditRegistry and the University of Lagos, through its Entrepreneurship and Skills Development Centre (ESDC), to integrate the Africa Consumer Credit Academy (ACCA) curriculum into the Centre’s programmes. The initiative is intended to strengthen financial literacy through learning opportunities, mentorship, certification and engagement with industry. Speaking on Monday, 23 November 2026, on the theme “The Dual-Mandate NCE-Degree Programme: Prospects, Challenges and the Future of Teacher Education in Nigeria,” he described the programme as an important opportunity to reposition teacher education. For decades, Colleges of Education depended on university affiliations to award Bachelor’s degrees, despite many possessing the academic capacity to run such programmes. The Federal Colleges of Education Act 2023 changed this, empowering eligible institutions to award degrees independently. Under the Dual-Mandate programme, students can complete three years of NCE training and proceed to another two years for a Bachelor’s degree in Education. With Nigeria facing an estimated shortage of one million teachers, he also called for greater integration of vocational education, artificial intelligence and digital skills into learning. “AI can explain a quadratic equation at midnight, but it cannot offer the steady, empathetic guidance of a caring adult,” he said, emphasizing that artificial intelligence must complement, not replace, the human qualities of effective teaching. entertainment.description: Nollywood icon Pete Edochie, MON, who passed away at the age of 79 in Enugu. Photo Credit: Pete Edochie/Instagram Nollywood and the wider African entertainment community are mourning the loss of one of their most respected screen icons, Pete Edochie , MON, who passed away on Wednesday, 25 November 2026,at the age of 79. According to an official statement released on behalf of the family by his eldest son, Leo Pete Edochie , the veteran actor and retired broadcaster departed this life at 12:30 a.m. in Enugu, Nigeria, following a protracted battle with prostate cancer. Born on 7 March 1947 in Zaria, Kaduna State, and hailing from Akamnato, Ifite Nteje in Anambra State, Pete Edochie began his career in broadcasting long before becoming a household name on television and cinema screens. At age 20, in 1967, he joined the Eastern Nigeria Broadcasting Service (ENBS)—later the Anambra Broadcasting Service (ABS)—rising steadily through the ranks to serve as Director of Programmes and Deputy Managing Director. His defining breakthrough came in 1987 when he portrayed the fierce, tragic hero Okonkwo in the Nigerian Television Authority’s (NTA) acclaimed television adaptation of Chinua Achebe ‘s Things Fall Apart. His commanding presence and deep, resonant voice earned him international recognition—including a dedicated delegation interview from the BBC—and cemented his place in Nigerian television history. Over a screen career spanning nearly four decades, Pete Edochie became synonymous with authority,traditional wisdom, and unforgettable Igbo proverbs. Whether playing stern monarchs, principled elders, or complex patriarchs, he delivered every line with unmistakable gravitas. His extensive filmography includes standout appearances in classics and modern hits alike, such as Things Fall Apart (1987), Igodo (1999), Egg of Life (2003), Oracle (2003), Billionaires Club (2003), End of Money (2005), Lionheart (2018)—where he starred as Chief Ernest Obiagu alongside Genevieve Nnaji—Unroyal (2020), and Foreigner’s God (2022). In recognition of his immense contributions to Nigerian arts and culture, he was conferred with the national honour of Member of the Order of the Niger (MON) in 2003 by former President Olusegun Obasanjo,alongside the Africa Magic Viewers’ Choice Awards (AMVCA) Industry Merit Award and lifetime achievement honours from the Africa Film Academy and the African Film Festival (TAFF). sports.description: Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Aaron Rodgers’ controversial comments about Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy drew all sorts of reactions online, but they probably shouldn’t have come as the biggest surprise, considering their tenure together with the Green Bay Packers also ended poorly, albeit in a much less public manner. sports.title: Milan fight back to beat Olympiacos in Europa League
sports.description: FILE PHOTO - The UEFA Europa League logo is pictured at the Europa-Park Stadium. (is associated with: «Milan fight back to beat Olympiacos in Europa League») Harry Langer/dpa AC Milan produced a second-half fightback from 2-0 down to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Piraeus and kick-start their Europa League campaign. After a low-key start at the Stadio Georgios Karaiskakis, Olympiacos broke the deadlock from a corner in the 31st minute. Former Inter defender Lorenzo Pirola crashed a header against the crossbar and the ball bounced back into the net off Mike Maignan’s arm. Milan – who had lost three of their four previous Europa League games – were close to a swift equalizer in the 35th minute. Alphadjo Cisse raced onto a through pass as Olympiacos keeper Stefan Ortega rushed out, and then stabbed the loose ball goalwards only for Pirola to hack it clear as he slid on into a post. Pirola then missed a chance to double Olympiacos’ lead in stoppage time at the end of the first half when he fired over from 10 yards. Olympiacos, who were unbeaten in Europe with three wins, scored again four minutes into the second half. Remo Freuler found Jota Silva at the edge of the penalty area and he fired the ball past Maignan into the top corner. Milan got themselves back into the match through a fine individual goal from Omari Hutchinson in the 56th minute. The on-loan Nottingham Forest winger picked the ball up on the halfway line and burst down the right before cutting inside at the edge of the penalty area and rolling the ball into the far corner. The Rossoneri struck again in the 63rd minute when Hutchinson sent over a floated cross from the right towards the back post where Cisse nodded the ball past Ortega. Substitute Christian Pulisic completed the turnaround with 20 minutes left when he volleyed home a cross from the right after more quick footwork from Hutchinson. Diego Moreira swept home a fourth in added time following a swift counterattack by Pulisic.

It was a remarkable 10th victory in a row in all competitions for Marco Rose’s side and it might have been the most satisfying of the lot for the manager, coming as it did after his team had found themselves a goal down and a man down at half-time. The visitors looked in trouble when, minutes after Iago Aspas had curled Celta in front, Bafode Diakite was red-carded for a poorly timed tackle. Bournemouth might have folded then, but instead they came roaring back, Alvaro Rodriguez heading them level almost immediately after the start of the second half. A draw would have been an excellent result in the circumstances. Substitute Rayan had other ideas, waiting at the end of a rapid breakaway to sweep in the winner 12 minutes from time. Victory against Viktoria Plzen in December will almost certainly now be enough to earn direct passage to the last 16.

New Canaan forced two turnovers which led to touchdowns in the first 3:05 and rolled to its ninth consecutive Turkey Bowl victory 33-13 over Darien Thursday in Darien. The No. 4-ranked Rams (8-2) had already unofficially secured a Class L tournament berth before the game, but the victory secured a home game for the quarterfinals, which are set for Tuesday. On the Blue Wave's next possession, Dallas George intercepted a High Dunlop pass and set New Canaan up at the Darien four-yard line. George then carried it in for a four-yard touchdown run and an early 14-0 lead. Kicker Neel Arora followed with field goals of 32 and 35 yards, and a blocked punt by Jack Nicolet led to a 13-yard return by George and the Rams had a 27-0 lead at halftime. sports.title: Ohio State gets more bad news as criticism mounts for Ryan Day
sports.description: An Ohio State Buckeyes helmet sits behind the endzone as the team warms up for its game against the Michigan Wolverines during the NCAA football game at Michigan Stadium in Ann Arbor, Mich. on Nov. 29, 2025. Ohio State won 27-9. It’s been a rough few weeks for the Ohio State Buckeyes and head coach Ryan Day. Ohio State has dropped three of its last four games and fallen out of the College Football Playoff picture, and the pressure on Day has only continued to grow heading into Saturday’s game against the Michigan Wolverines. Now, things have gotten even worse. Five-star edge rusher David “DJ” Jacobs, one of the top recruits in the country, has decommitted from Ohio State on Thanksgiving, just two days before the Buckeyes’ rivalry game and days before the early signing period. Ohio State’s Disappointing Season The Buckeyes entered the season with national championship expectations, but they’ve stumbled to a 7-4 record. Ohio State lost to Texas in Week 2, then fell to USC, Oregon, and Nebraska after star quarterback Julian Sayin suffered a season-ending arm injury. The criticism has been coming from everywhere. Ohio State legend Cris Carter ripped the program this week, questioning the communication within the coaching staff and saying that “the film looks like we ain’t got no heart.” Some Buckeye fans have already laid out the case for firing Day , pointing to the program’s failures in player development and game management. And with Michigan coming to Columbus on Saturday, Day’s seat is only going to get hotter if the Buckeyes lose. Jacobs Decommits On Thursday afternoon, national recruiting reporter Hayes Fawcett broke the news that Jacobs had backed off his commitment from Ohio State. “BREAKING: Five-Star Plus+ EDGE David ‘DJ’ Jacobs has Decommitted from Ohio State, he tells me for @Rivals. He’s ranked as the No. 1 Recruit in the 2027 Class,” Fawcett wrote . Jacobs, a 6-foot-5 edge rusher from Blessed Trinity Catholic in Roswell, Georgia, is the top-ranked edge rusher in the 2027 class and the No. 2 overall prospect in the 247Sports composite. He was the crown jewel of Ohio State’s 2027 class. Jacobs committed to the Buckeyes last December, announcing his decision on live television just days before Ohio State’s College Football Playoff quarterfinal against Miami. He picked Ohio State over a long list of suitors, including Georgia, where his father played, as well as Miami and Texas A&M. Tennessee and Georgia have continued to pursue him throughout his commitment, and both are expected to be in the mix now that his recruitment is back open. Needless to say, losing the top recruit in the country on Thanksgiving is about the last thing Day needed heading into The Game. sports.description: On Saturday night, one of college football's premier annual rivalries will be renewed when Alabama hosts Auburn for the latest chapter of the Iron Bowl. Not only has Alabama won the last six games against Auburn dating back to the 2020 season, but the Crimson Tide have also owned the recent series in Tuscaloosa winning the last seven, with each game's margin of victory coming by double digits. Saturday will mark the third time Alabama's defense has faced Auburn quarterback Byrum Brown in his career, with the former USF transfer having torched the Tide on the ground with 200 rushing yards in two prior games, despite struggling as a passer. Brown is certain to provide challenges for the Tide's defense again Saturday when running the ball, and will likely need to see success on the ground as Auburn's leading rusher has been hurt at times this season by turnovers, throwing eight picks. Can Alabama's pass rush take advantage of Auburn offensive line? Alabama's defensive front will be facing an Auburn offensive line that has struggled to protect the quarterback this season, with the Tigers currently ranking among the worst in FBS with 39 sacks allowed over 11 games. Alabama is tied for the fifth-most sacks in the SEC this season with 31, and have racked up a combined 13 during their current four-game winning streak. sports.title: Eight Short Game Shots Define Scoring Mastery For Serious Golfers
sports.description: Jerod Ringwald-Imagn Images A solid short game turns a bad round into a great one by saving strokes inside 80 yards. Golf Monthly identifies eight key shots every player must master to handle sand, rough, and slopes. These include the chip-and-run, chip-pitch, pitch, bunker shot, hybrid bunt, flop, upslope or downslope play, and a shot from the rough. The chip-and-run is the starting point for any good short game when obstacles are absent. According to reports, the shot allows the ball to start rolling earlier and leaves a large amount of green ahead. This method is the safest and most predictable way to knock the ball near the hole. Players should grip down the shaft and stand closer to the ball with 70% of their weight on the front foot. The Chip-Pitch And Pitch Shots When a player needs more carry than a chip but less speed than a full shot, the chip-pitch becomes the answer. This shot works well when a golfer is around 20 yards off the green and has room for the ball to release upon landing. The setup mirrors the chip-and-run but requires a slightly different feel to get the ball airborne without losing control. A standard pitch shot offers even higher flight and more distance. The motion involves more wrist action than the chip, allowing the player to stop the ball quickly on the green. Davies proposes visualizing wrist cock on a zero to five scale, with five indicating the maximum usage for a flop shot. Bunker And Hybrid Bunt Techniques Bunker play requires a specific technique to escape sand without losing distance or direction. The hybrid bunt can be used when a standard wedge does not work. The flop shot demands the most wrist action and is used to get the ball high and soft over an obstacle. It is the most difficult shot on the list and requires a precise touch to avoid hitting it too far or too short. Players must feel the clubhead slide under the ball while keeping their hands ahead of the clubhead at impact. Dealing With Slopes And Rough Slopes affect play, requiring players to adjust their aim and club selection for upslope or downslope lies. A shot from the rough adds another layer of difficulty as thick grass grabs the clubface and reduces spin. Converting three or four shots down to two elevates a player’s game to the next level. Davies stresses that sharp play from inside 80 yards lets a golfer exploit par 5s and short par 4s. The top five finishers at the Final Stage of PGA Tour Q School will earn membership for 2027.

sports.title: Former Atletico Madrid star defends Vinicius amid Real Madrid criticism: ‘If he scores 24 goals…’
sports.description: Former Atletico Madrid star defends Vinicius amid Real Madrid criticism: ‘If he scores 24 goals…’ Vinicius Jr.’s goal was the biggest takeaway for Real Madrid as they secured a thumping 5-1 win over PSV Eindhoven in the UEFA Champions League this midweek. The Brazilian scored the final goal of the game for Los Blancos . It was also his first goal for Real Madrid in three months, in what has been an underwhelming start to the season for the Brazilian. Although Vinicius has shown early signs of improvement of late, there is still widespread criticism over his performances and whether or not he deserves a place in the starting eleven. Mario Suarez on Vinicius Jr. While Real Madrid remain determined to help Vinicius Jr. get back to full form , former Atletico Madrid player Mario Suarez has offered his two cents on his situation. Vinicius Jr. has scored only two goals this season. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) A one-time Spanish champion with Atleti, Suarez talked about criticism surrounding Vinicius’ goal output, especially in relation to recent praise for Yan Diomande’s defensive work rate. “Football is what it is. Vinicius plays great games many times and, if he doesn’t score goals, he gets criticised. Now it’s praised that Diomande defends more than him,” he told COPE (h/t Defensa Central ). “If Vinicius scores 24 goals from now until the end of the season and Diomande scores 10, however much he defends, Vinicius will be praised more than Diomande. Football is like that and it’s all been invented,” he added. Suarez effectively means that attacking players are judged mainly on their end product, and the same is the case for Vinicius., who won’t be judged at the end of the season based on how much defensive work he puts in. A crucial month ahead for Vini and Diomande Suarez’s comment comes at a time when both Vinicius and Diomande are currently vying for a starting place in the Real Madrid eleven. For now, though, Diomande may be slightly ahead in the pecking order, having performed brilliantly since the end of the first international break. The Ivorian, though, hasn’t scored in the last four matches so Mourinho himself will have to make some tough decisions in the coming weeks.

sports.title: Dricus du Plessis claims UFC shot down Khamzat Chimaev rematch
sports.description: Dricus du Plessis and Khamzat Chimaev fought at UFC 319 | Ed Mulholland, Zuffa LLC Dricus du Plessis has been on the hunt for another fight with Khamzat Chimaev, even if the UFC isn’t interested for now. Chimaev defeated du Plessis at UFC 319 to become middleweight champion, only to subsequently lose the title to Sean Strickland at UFC 328. While Chimaev and Strickland settled their business, du Plessis returned to action at UFC Oklahoma City in July to pick up a five-round decision win over former welterweight champion Kamaru Usman. That performance kept du Plessis in the contender picture, which is currently murky with Strickland’s next title defense still to be announced, and Chimaev teasing a move up to light heavyweight while also keeping Strickland in his sights. Du Plessis told Fight Forecast he wanted a rematch with Chimaev, but has so far been denied. “I’ve asked for Khamzat now,” du Plessis said. “I asked for that fight. We said we want that fight and they said, no, they don’t want to do that right now. I said if that’s the next fight they want to make, I’m definitely keen. I’m definitely keen for that fight again. Believe me, he’s not fighting the same guy that he fought that night.” Du Plessis lost a disappointing decision to Chimaev as he struggled to deal with Chimaev’s wrestling for almost the entirety of their fight. He showed improvements in his wrestling defense against Usman, stopping all seven of his takedown attempts (per UFC Stats ). As much as he wants to avenge the Chimaev loss, du Plessis is always open to fighting Strickland again as well. Du Plessis is currently up 2-0 in their series, having won a razor-close split decision at UFC 297 to become champion and then winning another decision in their rematch at UFC 312. He expects a third fight to go the same way. “Absolutely, for me, like I always say, I want to fight for the belt,” du Plessis said when asked if he’s interested in a Strickland trilogy. “If he has the belt, that’s the guy I’m fighting. If that’s what needs to happen, that’s what I’ll do. “Kryptonite. That’s it, some guys just have another guy’s number and that’s it.” Du Plessis has recently been teasing fight news and though he still can’t make any official announcement, he expects his next opponent to be revealed soon. “I want to fight,” du Plessis said. “I said I’ll be ready to fight in February, but we’ve agreed to a fight. Me and the UFC, we’ve come to an agreement, and the big news will be out soon. I’m really happy to announce finally. The next fight, it’s not signed, but I’ve confirmed.”

technology.title: Microsoft: Hackers in China, N Korea using ARTEX AI tool to break into global tech systems
technology.description: Chinese and North Korean state-sponsored hacking crews are among the growing number of groups known for using the ARTEX pentesting tool in attacks, Microsoft said this week. ARTEX is an open source, AI-powered penetration testing framework that attackers have adopted to automate reconnaissance, credential attacks, and exploitation since its public release in July. Campaigns that have been linked to ARTEX have targeted cloud environments, IT software like ConnectWise , and financial institutions globally, sometimes reaching privileged access in under three hours. Salt Typhoon is arguably the most recognizable name on the list of ARTEX beneficiaries – the group responsible for attacks on telcos AT&T and Verizon , US government systems , UK prime minister's aides , and more. The lesser-known Crystal Typhoon – the group behind the ArcaneDoor attacks back when Microsoft called it Storm-1849 – was also named alongside it, as were North Korea's Onyx Sleet and Pearl Sleet. Microsoft also named China-state-aligned Storm-0940, linked to the ConnectWise compromise, and financially motivated, Cambodia-based Storm-3358. It had previously reported both groups' use of ARTEX. Chinese cybersecurity company ThreatBook claimed ownership of ARTEX in November. GitHub user "Autumn-27" originally published its source code with a Chinese-language interface in July. Various forks of the repo, which was taken down in October, have meant that the same framework is available in multiple languages. According to Infrawatch , there are more than 130 variants of ARTEX in circulation, and it is the most widely used agentic offensive framework (AOF) at present. Like other offensive security tools adopted by criminals, ARTEX can lower the effort required to mount attacks. Experienced groups can also use it to automate repetitive work and pursue multiple avenues at once. As Microsoft echoed this week, after the FBI and AWS issued their warnings earlier this month , ARTEX is proving to be a useful tool for the more sophisticated groups to streamline and hasten their attacks too. It's being used to help attackers steal AI and cloud credentials at "industrial scale," as AWS put it, which provide attackers access to advanced models for free. Microsoft says ARTEX can progress from reconnaissance to persistent, privileged access within minutes, depending on its configuration and the target's defenses. technology.title: Tech's outage problem needs maintenance, not conspiracy theories
technology.description: Years of technical debt, increasingly complex systems, and underinvestment in IT operations have left organizations vulnerable to major outages, according to Forrester. The analyst pointed to a seven-day stretch in November when failures disrupted Microsoft 365, US air traffic control, banking, and other critical services. The coinciding outages provoked "a slew of conspiracy theories about cyberattacks and AI," Forrester said. "The real culprit is tragically mundane: the culmination of decades of technical debt, the frenetic buildout of massively complex and highly interdependent systems, the concentration of risk, and the underinvestment in advanced operations." Forrester urged technology suppliers and in-house IT teams to prioritize resilience as their systems grow more complex. Otherwise, "the tech estate will collapse like a house of cards, taking down consumer and business trust with it." Earlier this month, Microsoft was left struggling to restore many of its cloud services after a core process running on some servers became "overwhelmed" and its attempts to fix the problem failed. Some of its services did not recover for another 24 hours. In October, Google Cloud blamed a "power event" for taking down multiple online products for customers in Western Europe. Affected services included BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Cloud Filestore, Cloud Run, Google App Engine, and Google Kubernetes Engine. In October last year , a major outage impacted Amazon Web Services (AWS), with even Amazon's own web page reported to be offline and dozens of other online services and websites affected. Aviation and banking were also hit this month. A communications outage triggered a nationwide ground stop in the US on November 13 , while incidents involving JPMorgan Chase, United Airlines, Apple, Workday, Gmail, and other services added to the sense of widespread instability. "Claims that these were all part of one connected cyberattack or conspiracy are highly unlikely. The real story is much more mundane," the report said . Forrester argued that organizations have prioritized visible improvements over repairs to the underlying technology. "Modernization investments have favored visible change over structural renewal," wrote report authors Lauren Nelson and Mark Moccia. "Organizations routinely fund new customer experiences, cloud migrations, platform consolidation, and AI initiatives because leaders can connect them to growth or productivity. "They are less enthusiastic about updating core systems, simplifying architectures, retiring obsolete components, and eliminating fragile interfaces. The result is a modern front end resting on an aging, brittle, and increasingly interconnected estate." Forrester's recommendations are to map dependencies, test failures and recovery under realistic conditions, and use incidents and near misses to identify weaknesses before they cause another outage. ®

technology.title: Rackspace pulls plug on Spot cloud service after security breach
technology.description: Rackspace is shutting down its low-cost Spot cloud service after a security breach, giving customers two weeks' notice to move their workloads and retrieve their data. In a notice posted on Tuesday , the cloud computing biz said its Rackspace Spot service will cease operations at 1700 Central Time (2300 UTC) on December 8. Any workloads still running at that point will be terminated, and customers will no longer be able to access their data. "Following the recent security incident affecting Rackspace Spot, Rackspace has made the decision to wind down the service," the company said. "Spot customers are being notified with the wind-down timeline, instructions for retrieving their data and steps to secure their environments." Customers will have to contend with the fallout from the breach while simultaneously trying to get their applications and data off the platform. According to a customer notification seen by The Register , the attackers used leaked credentials to access parts of Rackspace Spot over a period of almost 22 hours on November 17. Rackspace only learned of the intrusion the following day, after a customer raised the alarm. The intruders impersonated legitimate users, created pods in customer Kubernetes clusters, gained access to stored credentials known as Kubernetes Secrets, and listed nodes and storage volumes. "With that access, they could have read any Secret in an affected user's clusters, and any Spot API token or refresh token that user held," Rackspace told customers. Rackspace has since revoked the affected tokens and sessions, removed the pods planted by the intruders, and changed the affected platform and storage keys. Customers must also reissue API tokens, download new Kubernetes configuration files, and rotate credentials stored in their clusters, including database passwords and third-party API keys. Sirish Raghuram, co-founder and chief growth officer of Platform9, which co-developed Spot with Rackspace, shed some light on the root cause in a November 20 GitHub post. "An observability system was breached using a compromised credential," Raghuram wrote. "This was obviously a critical error on our part and we are very sorry we let this happen." Raghuram said the incident necessitated significant changes to the underlying infrastructure clusters, prolonging the outage. Spot's selling point was cheap compute. The service operated an auction-based pricing model, allowing customers to bid for cloud infrastructure at a fraction of the cost of conventional on-demand instances. Rackspace advertised savings of up to 90 percent for customers willing to tolerate interruptions to their workloads. A permanent interruption probably wasn't what they had in mind. Rackspace hasn't explained why it chose closure over recovery, revealed how many customers were affected, or said whether it will offer migration extensions. It did not respond to The Register's questions. ®

technology.title: Wyoming uranium operation shuts down after cyberattack

The Australian uranium producer said on Wednesday that it had activated its response procedures and brought in outside specialists following the attack on its US subsidiary, Strata Energy, which operates the Lance uranium project. Peninsula Energy said it believes the attack is "confined to the plant and wellfield operating and control systems," and that back-office functions, such as payroll and other corporate systems, in both the US and Australia, remain unaffected. "The company's immediate priorities have been to protect the safety of its employees, secure its operating systems, and work towards the restoration of operations in a safe and controlled manner," it said in an update to the Australian Securities Exchange. The notification [PDF] went on to say that Peninsula Energy's investigations into the attack, including whether any data was compromised, remain ongoing. Peninsula has not given a restart date and says it cannot yet assess the impact on its 2027 production guidance. Operations will remain suspended until recovery and safety checks are complete. "Peninsula will provide further updates to the market as material information becomes available," it said. The disclosure of additional information came two days after Peninsula secured a short trading halt, which referenced a cybersecurity incident at its Wyoming site. The November 23 filing [PDF] dated the incident to Friday evening in Western Australia. Wednesday's update clarified that Strata detected it on the morning of November 20, local US time. Peninsula subsequently requested a voluntary suspension of trading until the earlier of November 30 or an announcement on restarting operations and any resulting change to production guidance. Peninsula's Lance project is a uranium mining operation, extracting the element from underground deposits and turning it into uranium concentrate, aka yellowcake or U₃O₈. Uranium concentrate is feedstock for nuclear fuel production, typically undergoing conversion, enrichment, and fabrication into uranium dioxide pellets before use in reactors. The Lance central processing plant was constructed to produce a maximum of 2.0 million pounds (Mlb) of U₃O₈ annually, and is licensed for 3.0 Mlb. Peninsula previously forecast production of 500,000 to 600,000 pounds in 2027, having withdrawn its 2026 guidance earlier this year following operational problems at Lance. It now says it will reassess the 2027 outlook once operations resume. ®

technology.title: Company was religious about backups but sinned by leaving them exposed
technology.description: Welcome, once again, to PWNED, where we’re thankful every time someone leaves a password sticky note on a monitor or fails to delete a terminated employee’s admin account. But neither of those common occurrences is what we’ll be talking about today. Instead, our subject broke the number-one rule of backups: you gotta keep ’em separated. Our story comes courtesy of Da Li, who serves as global alliance manager at Info2Soft , a company that provides data protection and recovery software. At one point, a partner called him into a case where a Chinese vehicle parts manufacturer fell victim to a ransomware gang. Unfortunately, its backup was compromised too. The manufacturer had religiously backed up its manufacturing execution system (MES) and SAP orders, inventory, and finance systems every night. There was even a green dashboard that showed the backup process had succeeded, and someone checked that every morning. However, one Friday evening, crims broke into the network and found out that the backup server was joined to the same Windows domain as the rest of the network. The hackers found a plaintext password for the backup service account in a maintenance script on a file share and discovered that someone had used the very same password for a domain admin account. So the first thing the crooks did was delete every restore point on that backup server. Then they started encrypting the production servers to ransom them. “Every backup job had succeeded for three years,” Li said. “The failure was that the thing meant to save them could be reached with the same keys as the thing being attacked.” The results were devastating. With the MES and SAP data both gone, the plant couldn't schedule production, ship parts, or track them. By the time Li was called in, the plant had already resolved its ransomware situation. We don’t know whether it paid or not. The manufacturer did ask Li and his company to make sure that this couldn’t happen again. Li’s fix was not radical, but it was instructive. He made sure that the company now keeps its backup system outside the production domain, uses unique credentials, and requires MFA to reduce the risk of unauthorized access even if a password is compromised. He also made sure that the company keeps at least one offline backup and runs a test restore quarterly to ensure it’s prepared for emergencies.®

technology.title: Stale links on UK public sector websites direct visitors to gambling dens
technology.description: UK public sector websites are directing visitors to gambling promotions through old links to defunct local enterprise partnerships (LEPs), research by digital consultancy Digital Royalty has found. The consultancy identified 93 links across 79 pages on websites belonging to 26 public bodies. LEPs brought together councils and businesses to promote economic growth in England under a coalition government initiative launched in 2010. Central government funding ended in April 2024, with their core functions transferred to local and combined authorities. Among other things, Digital Royalty builds and looks after websites, which means chasing down old links. In August, it found that a link on Surrey County Council's website led to a former LEP address now displaying casino content. It went looking for more. Digital Royalty founder Alex De Sousa said: "Slow is usually a sign of caution and diligence, but 31 months after the LEPs wound up, it's crossed into inefficient and dangerous." The consultancy offered The Register four examples of websites run by the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS), Hull City Council, Parliament, and the Local Government Association. One example is a government page about the Digital Skills Partnership, originally published under an earlier incarnation of DCMS. The page includes a link that appears to be for the Humber Digital Skills Partnership within the Humber LEP website, but in fact takes users to a site advertising "Independent Non GamStop Casinos UK – New Casino Sites Outside GamStop." GamStop is the self-exclusion scheme designed to help people restrict their online gambling, which makes the links more concerning than ordinary website clutter. The same link appears on the Hull City Council website under a list of Joint Committees, Partnerships and Trusts where it appears as Local Economic Partnership (Humber LEP). An old page for the Parliament website detailing the Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy committee's Industrial Strategy report includes a footnote (135) that appears to be for the Business Central funding finder service, but takes the user to the "Highest RTP Non GamStop Casinos for UK Players." The Local Government Association's (LGA) sustainability and waste route map included a link to the former York and North Yorkshire LEP website. science.title: Venus shines at its brightest in the predawn sky this week. Here's where to look
science.description: null Venus is at its most dazzling in the predawn sky this week as it shines close to the bright star Spica in the southeast. Here's what you need to know. As an inner planet, Venus never strays far from the horizon, at least compared to outer planets like Jupiter and Mars which can be visible all night long during opposition, when they shine opposite the sun in Earth's sky. Instead, Venus alternates between morning and evening appearances. All the while, its shifting moon-like phases and ever-changing proximity to Earth causes its brightness to wax and wane. When is Venus at its most dazzling? Venus will reach peak brightness during its current morning apparition at 1:37 p.m. EST (1837 GMT) on Nov. 27 according to the astronomy website In-The-Sky . Stargazers in the U.S. could get an incredible view of Venus in the predawn hours of the coming week, as the planet climbs into the southeastern sky ahead of the rising sun, with Mercury clinging close to the horizon below. Celestron Nexstar 4SE (Image credit: Celestron) This is a fantastic go-to telescope with a 4-inch aperture and can help you quickly find a steady view of the moon. For a closer look at craters and the terminator, make sure to grab a 9mm or 12mm eyepiece and get stronger magnification. _ Celestron Nexstar 4SE review The bright star Spica will glow less than five degrees away from Venus before dawn on Nov. 27 — roughly the width of your three middle fingers held at arm's length against the night sky. Spica is a double system of two stars that orbit one another once every four days. Its stars are separated by just approximately 11 million miles (less than 18 million kilometers), making them far too close to split visually with even the most powerful amateur equipment. However, the system still makes for a dazzling target, appearing as a magnificent blue-white star when viewed through the eyepiece of a 4-inch telescope. Venus will appear close to Spica in the southeastern sky. (Image credit: Starry Night Pro 8) Check that the sun is safely below the horizon before turning your telescope on Venus to observe a crescent of light playing across the planet's dense atmosphere. Over the coming weeks and months, Venus will appear increasingly illuminated as it moves farther away from Earth in its orbit, while its apparent size through a telescope will gradually decrease. science.title: On this day in space! Nov. 26, 2011: NASA's 2-ton nuclear-powered Curiosity rover launches to Mars
science.description: null On November 26, 2011, the NASA Curiosity rover launched to Mars. The Mars rover Curiosity was the biggest and most powerful rover anyone had ever sent to the Red Planet. The 2-ton science laboratory is about the size of a small SUV. The mission's goal was to search for habitable environments on Mars , or evidence that the planet could have been habitable in the past. It launched on an Atlas V rocket from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida. About nine months later, Curiosity made a challenging landing on Mars. It successfully used a new landing technology called a sky crane to gently lower it to the surface. NASA's Curiosity rover lifts off atop a United Launch Alliance Atlas V rocket on Nov. 26, 2011 from Florida's Cape Canaveral Air Force Station. (Image credit: collectSPACE/Robert Z. Pearlman ) Why it mattered It may be hard to imagine now, but 15 years ago, the idea of a nuclear-powered rover on Mars was just a concept. When the Curiosity rover launched in 2011, it made that idea a reality the car-size probe (using a plutonium-based radioisotope thermoelectric generator that converts heat from radioactive decay into power) as it headed to the Red Planet. Curiosity was the largest rover ever launched to Mars, following up on the success of the tiny Sojourner rover in 1997 and the larger twin rovers Spirit and Opportunity in 2004. Its sky crane landing system was novel at the time, and fully automated. Once it began its descent in August 2012, NASA could only wait through "seven minutes of terror" to see how it turned out. It ended being a huge success. NASA's Curiosity rover on Mars. (Image credit: NASA) After its smooth landing, Curiosity lived up to its original name: the Mars Science Laboratory. Within weeks, Curiosity fulfilled its primary mission. It found evidence of ancient running water on Mars . It later found organic molecules on Mars as well. Curiosity's primary mission was expected to last just about one Martian year (687 Earth days, or about two Earth years), as the rover explored its Gale Crater landing site. But NASA has extended the mission as the rover continues to operate in good health. In fact, Curiosity has survived long enough to welcome its successor to Mars, the Perseverance rover , which landed in February 2021 on a mission to collect the first samples for later retrieval. Perseverance used the same basic 2-ton design, plutonium power system and sky crane landing system to reach Mars. And today, a ground-based twin of the Curiosity rover, called Promise , is being outfitted for an upcoming mission to the moon. Want more space history? science.title: Cosmic 'betta fish' glows in spectacular nebula portrait | Space photo of the day for Nov. 26, 2026
science.description: null An image captured by the Dark Energy Camera showcasing the Betta Fish Nebula. (Image credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/DOE/NSF/AURA) The striking blue of the Betta Fish Nebula swims across the cosmic landscape, a stunning wisp of material leftover from a stellar explosion. What is it? Roughly 6,800 light-years from Earth and nestled in the Centaurus constellation, this piece of the supernova remnant SNR G295.5+09.7 has earned the nickname the Betta Fish Nebula for its floaty, fishy shape. This almost ghostly whirl of gas and dust was created when a star much more massive than our sun exploded, blasting its outer layers of material outward in the process. Over time, the remnants of this supernova eruption stretched outward into space, dispersing and colliding with surrounding gas. The explosive remnants mixing with gas in the interstellar medium created this glowing, blue cloud. This celestial scene was captured by the Dark Energy Camera (DECam), that was created by the U.S. Department of Energy. The camera is installed on the National Science Foundation's Víctor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope in Chile. Why is it incredible? This image of a colossal, cosmic "fish" was captured by a camera meant to study the illusive effects of dark energy , which is the name scientists have given for whatever mysterious something is causing the universe to expand at an accelerating rate . The camera is used as part of the Dark Energy Survey, a six-year, international collaboration in which scientists have collected observations of hundreds of millions of galaxies, thousands of supernova and additional details about our cosmos that could help to fill in the picture of the nature of dark energy. And while researchers this past January revealed the initial result of this six-year survey, scientists continue to explore the possibilities of dark energy with DECam alongside instruments like the recently-launched Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. However, while the survey has lofty goals with its DECam data, the camera can also capture beautiful imagery like this cerulean wisp thousands of light-years away.

science.description: null If your household is like most American families, then on Thursday you likely will all be sitting down with family and friends for a traditional Thanksgiving turkey dinner during the mid-to-late afternoon hours. Then as darkness falls, some will probably migrate into the living room to catch some football or other holiday fare on television.
